customers_say: Customers find the water purifier excellent in quality and functionality, delivering clean, safe drinking water consistently and serving small families well. The installation process is quick and perfect, and they appreciate its elegant appearance. While some customers consider it good value for money, others say it's not worth the price. The service receives mixed reviews, with some praising the customer support while others report terrible service.

reviews.author: Sujata Das
reviews.title: A perfect Filter
reviews.body: I have got a very nice deal in Aquaguard Ritz Pro Filter. Service was prompt. The machine is functioning very nicely. Water quality is very clean.

reviews.author: Reshma
reviews.title: Good Value for Money
reviews.body: Good water purifier with good water quality. It is easy to use and works well. Overall, I'm satisfied with the product and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Moosa
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Smooth Installation
reviews.body: Great product and excellent value for money. Water tastes clean and fresh, and the purifier works perfectly. Installation was quick and smooth. The technician was professional, explained everything clearly, and checked the TDS after installation. Very satisfied with the purchase. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ani
reviews.title: Very much satisfied with the purifier
reviews.body: It has only been a few days, and the product looks very promising. The installation team also did a great job. We had a slightly unconventional setup: the RO unit was placed in our wash area, and we connected the purified water outlet to a spout in the kitchen to dispense the RO water. Initially, the technicians were hesitant because they didn't fully understand how to execute the setup, but they later agreed and finished the installation with a neat and professional finish the next day. I was also able to connect the RO to the internet successfully. The TDS reading displayed in the app differ

reviews.author: Frinto
reviews.title: MRP of the Bottle Provided
reviews.body: Just bought the water purifier two weeks before.. till now good.. i would like to comment on the bottle that they give free with an MRP of 2000₹.. I dont think the manufacturing will cost even 1/3rd of the MRP printed.. because the quality of the bottle does not match the MRP printed..
